title: Zesty Citrusy Greek Almonds Baklava
description: A citrusy and romantic Greek dessert featuring orange zest and a mother-sauce-base, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. This shaggy baklava is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced almonds, orange zest, honey, rose water, and cardamom powder.
Layer the phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with melted coconut oil.
Spread the almond mixture evenly over the phyllo dough layers.
Repeat the layering process two more times, ending with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the baklava from the oven and let it cool completely.
Drizzle with additional honey and rose water, if desired.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
